French translator of the Kashmir corpus: Vijnanabhairava (1961), Bhakti/Stavacintamani (1964), Maharthamanjari+Parimala (1968), Hymnes de Abhinavagupta (PICI 31, 1970; 2nd ed. 1986), Hymnes aux Kali (1975), Kundalini (1983), Sivasutra (1980), Tantraloka ch.1-5 with Padoux (1998), Vatulanatha w/ Anantasakti (1995). Her 1970 Hymnes intro dates the late hymns with the PTv works — our dating note. Eight hymns = Bodhapancadasika, Paramarthacarca, Anubhavanivedana, Bhairavastava, Paramarthadvadasika, Mahopadesavimsatika, Dehasthadevatacakra + Anuttarastika.
Bio. CNRS Directeur de recherche (1908-1993). Nine annotated translation volumes 1957-1990 (ICI fascicles). Her 1970 Hymnes dates the late stotras with the PTv works — independent confirmation of our works map; her corpus (Hymnes I) is our stotra checklist.
